subject: [PATCH 2/2] crypto: zstd - Avoid redundant dstream initialization

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the Zstandard decompression algorithm in the Linux kernel by avoiding redundant initialization of a shared workspace (DStream) when it's not necessary. The DStream is initialized only once, during the first iteration that reaches the streaming path, instead of being reinitialized at the beginning of each operation. This change improves performance by reducing unnecessary work and resulting in a 13.8% median time reduction for decompression operations on bare-metal hosts and a 35.6% reduction on KVM guests.
